The nonrainbow 3x3 adjacency matrix counts fixed basin; binary forbidden-000 matrix counts first fixed layer; 9-state pair matrix counts recurrent global rotations; 81-state four-window matrix counts one-step 3-cycle predecessors after 2^n spurious hub-stationary inputs removed.
